generic_name: Eyelid Cleansing Wipes (Hypochlorous Acid / Baby Shampoo / Sodium Hyaluronate formulations vary by brand)
purpose: These wipes are used to gently clean your eyelids and the base of your eyelashes. They help remove dirt, oil, makeup, debris, and crust that can build up around your eyes. They are especially helpful for people with blepharitis (eyelid inflammation), dry eye syndrome, or those who wear contact lenses or eye makeup regularly.
how_it_works: The wipes contain gentle cleansing ingredients that loosen and lift away oily buildup, dead skin cells, and bacteria from the edge of your eyelids. Keeping your eyelids clean helps the tiny oil glands along your eyelid edges work properly, which keeps your eyes moist and comfortable. A cleaner eyelid also reduces irritation, redness, and the risk of eye infections.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate these wipes very well. Occasionally, some people may notice mild temporary stinging, tingling, or a slight burning sensation right after use. If you have sensitive skin, you might experience mild redness around the eyelid area. These effects usually go away quickly.
warnings: Avoid getting the wipes directly into your eyes — use them on your closed eyelids and lash line only. Do not use if you are allergic to any ingredient listed on the package. If you notice increased redness, swelling, pain, or worsening irritation after use, stop using them and contact your eye doctor. Do not reuse a wipe — each wipe should be used once and discarded. Keep out of reach of children.
typical_dosing: Most people use one wipe per eyelid, once or twice a day. Gently close your eye, place the wipe on your eyelid, and softly wipe along the lash line from the inner corner to the outer corner. Use a fresh wipe for each eye. Your eye doctor may recommend a specific routine based on your condition, so follow their instructions if given.
